title: The lookup revalidation's content-date pass of confirmable is stated in tools.md and its eval row, or the lookup drops it
goal: factdiff.confirmable passes a fact whose baseline is newer than its confirmation when the page's own content date is no newer than the confirmation (as apply's kept() does); kb/_self/tools.md and the lookup_eval.csv row say so, or the lookup requires the baseline to be no newer, with a lookup case of a newer baseline and an old content date that asserts the chosen outcome. Found by the SP-djl7za6x review.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff; keeps=factdiff.confirmable({'baseline_utc':'2026-10-10T00:00:00Z','content_date':'2026-01-01'},'2026-09-01'); t=open('kb/_self/tools.md').read(); i=t.index('[current DATE]'); sys.exit(0 if (not keeps) or 'content date' in t[i:i+1200] else 1)

clauses.clause: factdiff.confirmable passes a fact whose baseline is newer than its confirmation when the page's own content date is no newer than the confirmation (as apply's kept() does)

notes: Premise: factdiff.confirmable({baseline_utc: 2026-10-10T00:00:00Z, content_date: 2026-01-01}, 2026-09-01) is True and False with an empty content date, while kb/_self/tools.md's revalidation line (the [current DATE] reading) and eval row EV-pack-revalidate-decide-fact-current-moved name only the baseline (run 2026-10-13 at base). The doc is the smaller change: state the content-date pass there, or drop it in confirmable and add the lookup case. Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 4 of 15, "Freshness and census: the down window, the confirmable rule, soft 404s, unlocated anchors and mirror licences"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Test ids are near the ceiling: extend the existing test that covers confirmable or the revalidation path and append the selector words to its name, a new id only when none does.
